description: This file defines the 'Link2' class which manages relationships between entities (beans) in the SuiteCRM framework. It handles loading, querying, adding, removing, and managing related beans through defined relationships, acting as an interface for relationship manipulation within the CRM.

classes.name: Link2
classes.description: Represents a relationship from a single bean's perspective, managing related beans via a specified relationship, including loading, querying, adding, and removing related entities.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a Link2 object, determining link definitions and establishing the relationship object based on the link name, focus bean, and link definition.

methods.name: loadedSuccesfully
methods.description: Returns true if the relationship was successfully loaded; false otherwise.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads related data into the link, performing a query with optional parameters.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Performs a database query on the relationship based on provided parameters.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Returns an array of IDs of related records, loading data if not already loaded.

methods.name: getRelatedModuleName
methods.description: Returns the module name on the other side of the relationship.

methods.name: getRelatedModuleLinkName
methods.description: Returns the link name used on the related module side.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of relationship: 'many' or 'one'.

methods.name: getFocus
methods.description: Returns the parent bean this link references.

methods.name: getRelatedFields
methods.description: Returns related field definitions.

methods.name: getRelatedField
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a specific related field.

methods.name: getRelationshipObject
methods.description: Returns the relationship object associated with this link.

methods.name: getSide
methods.description: Determines if this link is on the left-hand side (LHS) or right-hand side (RHS) of the relationship.

methods.name: isParentRelationship
methods.description: Checks if this is a parent relationship (e.g., for activities).

methods.name: getJoin
methods.description: Returns the join query for this relationship, optionally as an array.

methods.name: getQuery
methods.description: Returns a query string or array to retrieve IDs related through this link.

methods.name: getSubpanelQuery
methods.description: Returns a subpanel join query for this relationship.

methods.name: getBeans
methods.description: Returns an array of related SugarBean objects, loading them if necessary, with optional query parameters.

methods.name: beansAreLoaded
methods.description: Checks if related beans have been loaded.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Creates a relationship between the focus bean and related beans, with optional additional values.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes the relationship between the focus bean and specified related beans.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes all relationships for the focus bean or specific related entity.

methods.name: getRelatedBean
methods.description: Returns a related Bean instance given an ID.

methods.name: __get
methods.description: Magic getter for retrieving relationship-related properties like type, beans, or rows.

methods.name: __set
methods.description: Magic setter for properties like 'beans'.

methods.name: addBean
methods.description: Manually adds a Bean object to the current relationship's loaded beans.

methods.name: removeBean
methods.description: Removes a Bean object from the current relationship's loaded beans.
